rules.statement: A plaintiff seeking rectification of a deed can maintain an action for partition even if the deed has not been formally rectified, provided that the mistake in the description is discovered after the institution of the action.
rules.supporting_quote: "As Lord Sterdale M. E. said in the latter case :- 'After rectification the written agreement .... is to be read as if it has been originally drawn on its rectified from ( Johnson v. Bragge 5 ) and it is that written document, and that alone, of which specific performance is decreed.'"
